establishes: engineering transport, numerical, convergence, runtime, memory, and cost facts for the registered full-layer S2 lenses
selected-public-item behavioral eligibility and frozen development/confirmation assignment when E0 completes
limitations: WikiText is a public Wikipedia-derived proxy, not the target model's known training distribution
two arm fits provide one independent difference trajectory, not a sampling distribution
matrix convergence and heldout apply stability are engineering evidence only
E0 estimates eligibility only on selected official public items
public benchmark labels are not private or researcher-blind
the independent Phase 1.0D capacity block remains unchanged
prohibits: J-lens validity classification before complete E1 and E2

eligibility.actual_sequence: first 128 token IDs supplied by the pinned force_bos=true adapter

overlap.operands: exact UTF-8 prompt bytes without normalization
overlap.rule: reject iff candidate equals protected, candidate is a contiguous substring of protected, or protected is a contiguous substring of candidate

corpus.role_key_bytes: UTF8(seed) || NUL || UTF8(immutable row ID) || NUL || ASCII(raw-text SHA-256) || NUL || ASCII(token-ID SHA-256)
corpus.sort: ascending hexadecimal role key with immutable row ID as collision-only tie-break
corpus.token_ids_hash_bytes: ASCII compact JSON integer array with separators comma and colon and no trailing newline

lock_required_fields: frozen S3 protocol and schema hashes
target model and tokenizer revision and parameter dtype
A600, B600, M1200 byte hashes and S2 manifest hash
E0 image digest and source bundle hash
official row order and expected item counts
E0 output schema and manifest destination
zero pre-lock benchmark tokenizer and model operations
e0.model_calls: exactly one clean greedy next-token forward pass per official item after lock readback
e0.prompt_mode: exact raw official bytes, no chat template, no generated chain of thought
e0.split: frozen distribution-local hash split from the frozen S3 protocol

fit.aggregation: official per-prompt mean and cross-prompt arithmetic mean
fit.primary_merge: official n_prompts-weighted merge A600 plus B600 equals M1200
fit.target_position_semantics: current-and-future positions exactly as implemented at the pinned J-lens commit

across_layer_summary: maximum and median relative Frobenius distance
checkpoint_per_layer: A versus B relative Frobenius distance
official merge versus independent n_prompts-weighted float32 recomputation
wall time and seconds per prompt
GPU type and peak allocated and reserved memory

scaling.fit: ordinary least squares of log D(n) on log n for n=64,128,256,600 with free exponent alpha
scaling.prior_diagnostic: D_prior(n,n) = 1.7 * sqrt(2/n), never an acceptance criterion

operational_artifacts.blob_policy: create-only with independent byte, size, and SHA-256 readback
operational_artifacts.image_policy: distinct S2 image addressed by digest with tag and manifest write and delete disabled
prefix_roles: smoke attempts and selected engineering configuration
every A and B subshard and resumable checkpoint
cumulative A64 A128 A256 A600 and B64 B128 B256 B600
independent verification and final S2 manifest
distinct S3 E0 lock output and manifest
operational_artifacts.repository_policy: small public manifests, hashes, schemas, summaries, bounded logs, provenance, and retrieval coordinates only; no large lens binaries

shards.failed_attempt_policy: preserve every attempt; resume only its own exact checkpoint under identical image, corpus, configuration, and shard identity

final_increment_planner.maximum_size_formula: floor(fit budget / observed selected-smoke seconds per prompt)

shards.parallelism: independent registered subshards only when GPU quota permits

smoke.selection: largest descending candidate passing every layer and identity check against dim_batch=1
smoke.t4_failure_policy: if dim_batch=1 cannot complete, repeat unchanged procedure on an available larger Azure GPU; never reduce sequence length or layers
